W.note: Restrained violet glow and halo with three real cubic-bezier readings, a 600 ms glow tail and a 400 ms exit, all gated for reduced motion, focus and touch; the lab panel clutters the page but the button reads as a real control.

X.note: The hover shifts the gradient toward rose, adds a sheen sweep and a glow, and the stays page looks like a finished product; the letter-spacing and box-shadow transitions cost some layout and paint, but reduced motion and focus are handled.

Y.note: The ink button's sheen sweep and violet aura look good, but the aura runs an infinite ease-in-out loop on hover, the hover is not gated to fine pointers, and several tiles use backdrop blur.

Z.note: Live contrast checks, focus ring and disabled state are strong, but a :root:not(.motion-full) .btn rule overrides the lift and curve variables, so by default there is no lift and only a 150 ms linear fade until the user picks Full, which defeats the curve readings.
